name: Nova
comment: Deliberately minimal. nova-lsp classifies every token itself and publishes semantic tokens (Nova.LSP.SemanticTokens), which is what actually colours a .nova file; this grammar only covers the moment before the server has answered, and files the server could not load. Keeping it to comments, reserved words and numbers avoids a second, drifting copy of the lexer — anything richer belongs in the server.

keyword.comment: The reserved words of Nova.Elaboration.Parser. The lookarounds rather than \b keep `Z'` and `data'`, which are ordinary identifiers, from matching.
keyword.name: keyword.other.nova

constant.comment: Reserved constants and constructors, both spellings. The Unicode forms are not identifier characters, so they need no lookarounds.
